newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech PX50 closes slightly higher.
newsitem.headline: Czech PX50 closes slightly higher.

text.p: Czech shares rose slightly on Friday but turnover remained low
"Trading is dying, nobody is interested in anything and foreign investors are ignoring the Czech market," said Miroslav Nosal of Patria Finance.
The PX50 index edged up 0.5 points, 0.09 percent to 538.8 while the major issue dominated RPIX index of continuously traded shares dropped 0.1 points, 0.01 percent to 1,124.9.
